description:
Save a chart, a table or a dataset to the user's private workspace. Needs the Pro plan; on other plans it returns PLAN_REQUIRED. Use it when the user asks to keep, save or store a chart, table or data.
Chart or table of an indicator for up to 10 places, read live every time it is opened: {"kind": "chart", "title": "Unemployment, Texas vs California", "indicator": "unemployment_rate", "places": ["Texas", "California"], "from": "2015"}.
Dataset of the user's own rows (up to 20,000 rows and 30 columns; an MCP request carries at most 256 KB, so send larger tables through the dashboard upload): {"kind": "dataset", "title": "Store sales 2025", "columns": ["month", "sales"], "rows": [["2025-01", 1200], ["2025-02", 1350]]}.
Every row must have one value per column and column names must be unique; otherwise the call fails with INVALID_ARGUMENT naming the row.
Returns {id, kind, title, size_bytes, created_at, updated_at, warnings?}. warnings names places that have no data yet and repeated titles; tell the user. The user can open it at https://invokely.ai/dashboard/workspace. To change an item later, use workspace_update, which keeps the id.

description.description: dataset only. Optional note on what the data is.

frequency.description: Optional. Force a frequency when the indicator exists in several (for example monthly and annual unemployment).

from.description: chart and table only. Optional first period.

indicator.description: chart and table only. Indicator id from search_indicators, for example "population", "registered_unemployment_rate", "unemployment_rate", "cpi_annual_change", "net_income_per_person".

kind.description: chart or table (a saved view of an indicator) or dataset (rows you provide).

places.description: chart and table only. Place names or ids.

items.description: Place name or id. Examples: "Mataró", "Barcelona", "provincia de Barcelona", "Cataluña", "España", "Germany", "EU", "es-mun-08121", "08121" (INE code), "ES51" (NUTS), "Texas", "Travis County, Texas", "us-county-48453", "fips:48453" (US county FIPS), "Austin, TX", "us-place-4805000", "fips:4805000" (US city GEOID).

rows.description: dataset only. One array per row, in column order.

to.description: chart and table only. Optional last period.

name: workspace_save
title: Save to the workspace
